serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhNormal
Big Daddy: So, what’s the situation?
You: Don’t be scared, ok? They wanted me to transport a package, but the package is…
Big Daddy: Let me unwrap this thing.
#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhSerious
Big Daddy: Oh.
Big Daddy: It’s a gun.
You: Y-yeah, I thought so…
Big Daddy: If I knew about that sort of development I would prepare some countermeasures.
You: B-but the blog post wasn’t saying anything about this! It was supposed to be some electronics! 
Big Daddy: They are a violent bunch and master manipulators.
Big Daddy: Listen, I have no equipment on hand to put any tracking device on this thing in time.
Big Daddy: You need to go back and finish your mission. This time there’s nothing else we can do.
You: W-what?! But someone might get killed if I do this?!
Big Daddy: If we want to stop them you cannot have your cover blown. Serial number of this gun has been removed so it’s a dead end. You need to continue.
You: But they want to kill someone with this!
Big Daddy: Nothing stops them from getting another gun, right? We are da good guys here. If we want to stop them, tough choices are bound to be made.
Big Daddy: Besides. If you don’t give them da gun back they might try to kill you, you know?
You: !
Big Daddy: There’s no time left, you need to go. I’m sorry.
You: Alright…
Big Daddy: After you finish, send me everything you have on them. I will come up with something.
You: …
